gloss: torrent of abuse; stream of insults

definitions.gloss: torrent of abuse; stream of insults; foul language
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound for every kind of insult and abusive language heaped on someone. Literary and emphatic; it stresses the quantity and viciousness of the words.

examples.japanese: {罵詈雑言|ばりぞうごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びせられた→浴びせる：31633_abiseru⟧。
⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{罵詈雑言|ばりぞうごん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あふれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The internet is overflowing with insults.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{罵詈雑言|ばりぞうごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}び→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦グラウンド→グラウンド：10813_guraundo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{去|さ}った→去る：02115_saru⟧。
examples.english: The manager who lost the game left the field amid a torrent of abuse from the crowd.

notes:
From {罵詈|ばり} (abuse, reviling) and {雑言|ぞうごん} (assorted abusive words). Note the reading ぞうごん, not ざつげん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {罵詈雑言|ばりぞうごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びせる→浴びせる：31633_abiseru⟧: to hurl abuse at someone
- {罵詈雑言|ばりぞうごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to be showered with abuse
- {罵詈雑言|ばりぞうごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧: a storm of insults

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暴言|ぼうげん}→暴言：12975_bougen⟧: abusive remark — a single outburst, common in news
- ⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧: badmouthing — everyday, often behind someone's back
- ⟦{罵|ののし}る→罵る：20839_nonoshiru⟧: to revile, to call someone names (the verb)
